title: Design System: KRIECHSTROM FM-1 Jam Board

body.purpose: Default 15px / 500 Inter Tight with tabular numerals.

tempo.purpose: BPM readout in the top bar.

stepper-value.purpose: Large numeric value in drawer steppers.

cell.purpose: Step numbers and step marks in cells.

shadows.name: playhead-header-bar
shadows.purpose: Only shadow-property use in the build: playhead bar under the roll header cell. No blurred shadows exist.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Drawer slide and track resize (.35s), switch knob (.25s). All transitions are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Square 44px touch button; pressed state inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #707070; background: #191919; color: #f2f2f2; font: 700 15px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:active { background: #222; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-on { background: #f2f2f2; color: #000; border-color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-red { background: #ff2018; color: #000; border-color: #ff2018; }

components.name: Play Button
components.description: Transport. Red when stopped, ink while running.
components.css: .ds-play { width: 64px; min-height: 48px; background: #ff2018; color: #000; border: 1px solid #ff2018; font: 700 15px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-run { background: #f2f2f2; border-color: #f2f2f2; }

components.name: Step Cells
components.description: Off, on, tie, rest and playhead states of a step cell.
components.html: 1
components.css: .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 48px); gap: 3px; } .ds-cell { position: relative; height: 56px; background: #191919; border: 1px solid #707070; color: #c4c4cc; font: 700 12px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-on { background: #ff2018; border-color: #ff2018; color: #000; } .ds-tie { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #ff2018 0 6px, #000 6px 9px); border-color: #ff2018; } .ds-rest { background: #0d0d0d; } .ds-now::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 6px; background: #fff; }

components.name: Track Head
components.description: Track name with number badge, sound, and mute toggle.
components.html: 1KICK
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; width: 232px; border: 1px solid #707070; background: #191919; color: #f2f2f2; font-family: 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-name { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-num { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #ff2018; color: #000; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; } .ds-snd { font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; } .ds-mute { width: 44px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid #707070; background: none; color: inherit; font: 800 15px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mute:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mute[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ff2018; color: #000; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; width: 240px; border: 1px solid #707070; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #707070; background: none; color: #f2f2f2; font: 700 15px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #f2f2f2; color: #000; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Drawer option chip; selected fills red.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; min-width: 64px; border: 1px solid #707070; background: #191919; color: #f2f2f2; font: 700 15px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ff2018; color: #000; border-color: #ff2018; }

components.name: Slider
components.description: 6px hairline track with a square 22x34 thumb.
components.css: .ds-range { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 240px; height: 44px; background: transparent; margin: 0; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 6px; background: #707070; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 34px; margin-top: -14px; background: #f2f2f2; border: 0; border-radius: 0; } .ds-range:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Clock Switch
components.description: 52x30 square switch; red track with black knob when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; font: 700 15px 'Inter Tight', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-tr { width: 52px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid #707070; background: #191919; position: relative; } .ds-tr::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px; background: #c4c4cc; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.19, 1, .22, 1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] .ds-tr { background: #ff2018; border-color: #ff2018; } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] .ds-tr::after { transform: translateX(22px); background: #000; }

narrative.overview:
Black ground, white type, one red. Four tracks stay on screen as rows of 16 step cells; exactly one track is "in hand" and grows to fill the height with its roll or lanes, while the other three stay thin and live. A drawer slides in from the right for per-step detail. Nothing is hidden, only folded.

The build is flat and hard-edged: square corners, 1px hairlines, no shadows, no blur. Red means active; white means selection, the track in hand, and the playhead. Touch is the primary input, so every control is at least 44px.
keyCharacteristics: Red marks every active step, mute-on, play, and the connection-level warning; it is never decoration.
White (and the pale ink fill) marks "where you are": track in hand, playhead, selected step, pressed toggle.
Square cells separated by 3px gaps, with a 6px extra gap at each beat.
Depth is a change of fill and border colour, never a shadow.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears only where something is active, armed, or needs attention. A new surface does not get a second accent.

rules.name: The White Is Position Rule
rules.body: White marks the track in hand, the playhead, the selected step and the focus ring. It never marks "on"; that is red.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Distinguish roles with weight 500/700/800 first; sizes stay in a narrow 11-26px band for controls.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Depth is fill and border only. State changes swap fill colour; nothing lifts.

dos: Do use red only for active, armed or attention states, with black text on it.
Do use white to mark position: track in hand, playhead, selection, focus.
Do keep every touch target at least 44px and every edge a 1px hairline (#707070).
Do keep corners square and depth flat; change fill, not elevation.
Do use Inter Tight with tabular numerals, and carry hierarchy with weight.
Do keep motion short on cubic-bezier(.19, 1, .22, 1) (.25s for switch knob, .35s for drawer and track resize) and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour.
Don't use rounded corners, shadows, glow or smooth gradients.
Don't hide the other three tracks when one is in hand; they stay thin and live.
Don't add decorative icons; icons only label an action.
Don't use red text on black for body copy; red-on-black text is reserved for the brand word and note tags.
